BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry FitzGerald O'Donovan are thrilled to present this well-maintained detached four bed house to the open market. Situated on a mature corner site extending to approximately 0.21 acres, this offers an excellent opportunity to acquire a comfortable family home in a convenient and desirable location just minutes from Cobh town.

The property has been lovingly cared for and is presented in very good condition throughout. While ready for immediate occupation, it offers the would-be-buyer to put their own stamp on it.

Accommodation is bright and welcoming, with oil-fired central heating, double-glazed windows, and well-proportioned rooms throughout. Externally, the generous site provides ample garden space and enjoys the added benefit of a detached garage.

Located just 2km from Cobh town centre, the property enjoys easy access to a wide range of amenities. Lidl, Aldi and SuperValu are all conveniently situated along the route into town, while both primary and secondary schools are also within the same short distance.

With its attractive corner site, detached garage, excellent location and well-maintained condition, this property offers a fantastic opportunity for buyers seeking a family home with plenty of potential to modernise and add value over time.
